summary: [Stripe] rate-limits: Official (docs.stripe.com/rate-limits): global 100 req/s live, 25 req/s sandbox; per-endpoint 25 req/s; tighter buckets: PI 1000 updates/object/hour, subscriptions 10 new invoices/min (20/day), Files 20+20/s, payouts 15 creates/s + 30 concurrent, Connect account create 30/s live (5/s sandbox), Search 20 reads/s. 429 + Stripe-Rate-Limited-Reason header; separate concurrency limits.
